52:40 - Q&A: Addressing the real questions from district leaders

As a leader, you know that "innovation" only works if it actually helps a teacher on a Tuesday morning. We’ve moved past the hype of AI to focus on human-centered support that fits into your schools’ existing goals. Watch to see how districts are using Khanmigo to give students a personal tutor and teachers a tireless assistant—all while keeping data safety and human connection at the center.
title: Fireside Chat with Sal Khan and Dr. Amy Alzina
